These teas work by providing antibacterial and anti-inflammatory properties that help to reduce pain, swelling, and infection in the ears. Some examples of herbal teas used to treat ear infections include peppermint tea, which helps to reduce inflammation and ease pain, ginger tea, which has antibacterial properties that combat infection, and eucalyptus tea, which helps to clear mucus and promote healing. Other herbal teas, such as echinacea, sage, and mullein, are also used to treat ear infections due to their anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties, making them a popular natural remedy for this common ailment.
